scope: Four local native rooms and 40 loopback WebSocket clients for eight seconds
limits: Clients use loopback and neutral inputs, so these RTT and jitter values do not represent internet play.
The CPU figure measures the host Node process only; the RSS figures separately sample the host and four native engines.
Host RSS is sampled every 100 ms and native engine RSS every 500 ms; reported peaks are the largest sampled values.
The macOS ps sampler passed; the Linux /proc sampler was not exercised on this machine.
Rooms are drained before match completion; this run does not measure replay sealing or verifier memory.
This does not measure physical-device frame pacing or human match quality.
